# Disagreement Log — GTH_088

**Date:** 2026-03-17
**Saying:** 88
**Agents:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA

---

## Disagreements

| # | Verse | EMET | LOGOS | PNEUMA | Issue |
|---|-------|------|-------|--------|-------|
| 1 | 88 | "messengers" | "angels" | "Messengers" | *angelos*: ambiguity of divine vs. human messenger |
| 2 | 88 | "say to yourselves" | "say among yourselves" | "ask yourselves" | Reflexive: interior speech vs. communal vs. questioning |
| 3 | 88 | "receive what is theirs" | "take what is theirs" | "claim what belongs to them" | Divine portion: receive vs. take vs. claim |

**Total disagreements: 3**

---

**Resolution:** SOPHIA adopts "messengers" (preserving ambiguity), "say to yourselves" (interior/reflexive), and "receive what is theirs."
